name: actions
reason: Reviewed both nested helpers: they capture inputs already in the manual keys. Compiler scope names those closures separately; retaining the context identity is intentional.

name: handleOpenChange
reason: clearPendingClose reads stable refs and state setters. Keep the callback identity for the dialog open-change consumer.

name: handleCancel
reason: clearPendingClose reads stable refs and state setters. Retain the cancellation callback identity.

name: handleDiscard
reason: advancePendingClose reads stable refs and setters. Remaining reactive inputs match; retaining the consumer callback identity is intentional.

name: handleSave
reason: advancePendingClose has no changing render input. Remaining reactive inputs match; retaining the save callback identity is intentional.

name: handleMouseDown
reason: The callback reads id and selectResult. The compiler merges it with row and virtual-scroll work; the narrower handler keys preserve identity across scroll updates.

name: fileState
reason: fileState reads exactly the manual keys. Metadata changes update the separate fileVersion derivation; the narrower state identity is intentional.

name: ref
reason: Returned DOM ref owns ResizeObserver cleanup. Stable callback identity avoids detaching and re-observing when its caller renders.

name: ref
